bounded_correction_class.candidate_support: For each scalar family and block, exactly the oriented primitive one-body monomials already present in that scalar's protected T3-009 coefficient support and touching the selected block.

coefficient_envelope.normalization: one independent rational coefficient per declared scalar-family x support-locked correction weight

local_correction_response.principle: A correction weight G attached to a protected regularized flux family contributes the exact shifted-scalar product-rule coefficient Delta_channel(G)=G(shift)-G.
local_correction_response.construction_order: Construct the oriented primitive harmonic shift exactly first, including protected pinv increments, then apply the exact shell-stratum restriction.
local_correction_response.protected_pinv: pinv_r(x)=x^(-r) for integer x>0 and 0 for integer x<=0
local_correction_response.scope: Necessary local coefficient response only. Cross-channel shared-coefficient compatibility, cross-block leakage, finite-boundary assembly, and full flux substitution are deferred to later exact solution extraction and recombination.

block_projection.membership: An exact coefficient coordinate belongs to a block projection when its oriented primitive harmonic monomial contains at least one letter whose protected k<->l orbit representative lies in that block.
block_projection.interpretation: The four block systems are local necessary projections, not a disjoint proof decomposition.

rank_consistency.coordinate_basis: scalar label x oriented primitive harmonic monomial x exact affine-Laurent signature

mirror_policy.required_exact_check: Mirror every l1 target coordinate, correction column, scalar label, primitive letter, ordinary affine factor, and protected pinv factor back to k1 and require exact matrix equality on all 100 block x mirrored-stratum cells.

negative_classification_boundary.meaning: An EXACTLY_INCONSISTENT cell exactly excludes only SUPPORT_LOCKED_ORIENTED_ONE_BODY_DEGREE0_WEIGHT_CORRECTION_001 for that local projection.
